--atleast-pkgconfig-version.Name: --atleast-pkgconfig-version
--atleast-pkgconfig-version.description: Require at least the given version of pkg-config

--atleast-version.Name: --atleast-version
--atleast-version.description: Test whether the packages on the command line exist and are at least the specified version

--cflags.Name: --cflags
--cflags.description: Print pre-processor and compile flags required to compile the packages on the command line

--cflags-only-I.Name: --cflags-only-I
--cflags-only-I.description: Print parts of "--cflags" that define the header search path

--cflags-only-other.Name: --cflags-only-other
--cflags-only-other.description: Print parts of "--cflags" not covered by "--cflags-only-I"

--define-prefix.Name: --define-prefix
--define-prefix.description: Use the installed location of the .pc file to determine the prefix

--define-variable.Name: --define-variable
--define-variable.description: Set a global value for a variable, overriding the value in any .pc files

--dont-define-prefix.Name: --dont-define-prefix
--dont-define-prefix.description: Use the specified prefix variable value defined in the .pc file as the prefix

--errors-to-stdout.Name: --errors-to-stdout
--errors-to-stdout.description: If printing errors, print them to stdout rather than the default stderr

--exact-version.Name: --exact-version
--exact-version.description: Test whether the packages on the command line exist and are exactly the specified version

--exists.Name: --exists
--exists.description: Test whether the packages on the command line exist

--help.Name: --help
--help.description: Displays a help message and terminates

--libs.Name: --libs
--libs.description: Print link flags required to compile the packages on the command line

--libs-only-L.Name: --libs-only-L
--libs-only-L.description: Print parts of "-libs" that define library search path

--libs-only-l.Name: --libs-only-l
--libs-only-l.description: Print parts of "-libs" that specify which libraries to link to

--libs-only-other.Name: --libs-only-other
--libs-only-other.description: Print parts of "-libs" not covered by "--libs-only-L" and "--libs-only-l"

--list-all.Name: --list-all
--list-all.description: List all modules found in the pkg-config path

--max-version.Name: --max-version
--max-version.description: Test whether the packages on the command line exist and are at most the specified version

--mod-version.Name: --mod-version
--mod-version.description: Display the version information of the libraries specified on the command line

--msvc-syntax.Name: --msvc-syntax
--msvc-syntax.description: Output -l and -L flags in the form recognized by the Microsoft Visual C++ command-line compiler

--prefix-variable.Name: --prefix-variable
--prefix-variable.description: Set the name of the variable to be overridden instead of prefix when using --define-prefix

--print-errors.Name: --print-errors
--print-errors.description: Print errors if modules cannot be found or if an error occurs in parsing a .pc file

--print-provides.Name: --print-provides
--print-provides.description: List all modules the given packages provides

--print-requires.Name: --print-requires
--print-requires.description: List all modules the given packages requires

--print-requires-private.Name: --print-requires-private
--print-requires-private.description: List all modules the given packages requires for static linking

--print-variables.Name: --print-variables
--print-variables.description: Return a list of all variables defined in the package

--silence-errors.Name: --silence-errors
--silence-errors.description: Print errors if modules cannot be found or if an error occurs in parsing a .pc file

--static.Name: --static
--static.description: Output libraries suitable for static linking

--uninstalled.Name: --uninstalled
--uninstalled.description: Return successfully if any "-uninstalled" packages are being used, and return failure otherwise

--validate.Name: --validate
--validate.description: Check the syntax of a package's .pc file for validity

--variable.Name: --variable
--variable.description: Return the value of a variable defined in a package's .pc file

--version.Name: --version
--version.description: Display the version of pkg-config and terminates
